answer: Delegation signing is implemented primarily within `jetson/services/companion-api/src/companion_api/miku_bridge/delegation.py`, which generates wire-form values using keys managed by `agent_contracts.signing`. The core signing logic standardizes HMAC-SHA256 protocols in `jetson/packages/agent_contracts/src/agent_contracts/signing.py` while host-specific trust-root keys are configured in `jetson/services/agent-gateway/src/agent_gateway/delegation_sig.py`. Verification of these signed delegations is enforced by the gateway at runtime through logic contained in both `delegation_gate.py` and `group_device_delegations.py`.
